name: Ray-Bomb
doc: Ray-Bomb (X-ATM092's enemy attack): a muzzle in front of the caster charging, dust blown from it, a muzzle flash, the beam to the targets with its sparks, smoke, a shockwave ring and debris at the targets, the party thrown up and bounced back. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag010_ray_bomb.cpp) run on the program's memory.

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Timing
parts.doc: The director's timeline: its sounds, the screen flash, its end (draws nothing)

parts.title: Charge
parts.doc: The muzzle in front of the caster, its charge glows and the dust blown from it

parts.title: Muzzle flash
parts.doc: A prim model at the muzzle, shrinking

parts.title: Beam
parts.doc: The beam from the muzzle to the targets, spinning, its sparks

parts.title: Blast
parts.doc: Smoke puffs, the shockwave ring and debris at the targets

parts.title: Bounce
parts.doc: The party thrown up and bounced back (the damage on the targets)

groups.label: Muzzle
groups.doc: From the caster's effect point, turned with it: Up, Back

groups.label: Dust
groups.doc: From the muzzle, ticks First to Last: Count a tick (at most 6), speed Speed + rand % Spread

groups.label: Smoke
groups.doc: Ticks First to Last: 1-2 puffs at 5 spots, scale Scale + rand % Spread (the texture restored at First)

groups.label: Debris
groups.doc: Ticks First to Last: 2-3 pieces at 5 spots thrown up by Speed + rand % Spread

params.label: Muzzle sound
params.doc: Played at the muzzle at its tick

params.label: Blast sound
params.doc: Played at the targets with the shockwave

params.label: Flash in
params.doc: The screen flashes up until this tick...

params.label: Flash out
params.doc: ...and down from this one to the end

params.label: End
params.doc: The attack ends after this tick

params.label: Glows tick
params.doc: The charge glows start at this tick...

params.label: Glows
params.doc: ...this many

params.label: Glow growth
params.doc: Each glow grows by this a tick

params.label: Glow size
params.doc: Its size: this + rand % Glow size spread

params.label: Tick
params.doc: The muzzle flash at this tick

params.label: Scale
params.doc: Its scale (4096: its own size)...

params.label: Shrink
params.doc: ...down by this a tick

params.label: Tick
params.doc: The beam at this tick

params.label: Spin
params.doc: Its spin (4096: a turn)...

params.label: Spin step
params.doc: ...up by this a tick

params.label: Width
params.doc: Its width (4096: its own)

params.label: Shockwave tick
params.doc: The shockwave ring (and the blast sound) at this tick

params.label: Shockwave width
params.doc: Its width (4096: its own)

params.label: Shockwave rise

params.label: Tick
params.doc: The party thrown up at this tick

params.label: Dust
params.doc: The sprite sequence dust (a flipbook of 16 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Puff
params.doc: The sprite sequence puff (a flipbook of 1 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Spark
params.doc: The sprite sequence spark (a flipbook of 16 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Charge
params.doc: The sprite sequence charge (a flipbook of 16 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Ring model
params.doc: The prim model ring (a mesh of 144 vertices, 108 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))

params.label: Beam model
params.doc: The prim model beam (a mesh of 50 vertices, 36 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))

params.label: Flash model
params.doc: The prim model flash (a mesh of 55 vertices, 54 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))

params.label: Texture file
params.doc: The texture file its loader reads from the magic folder (a name of at most 31 letters)

params.label: Camera track
params.doc: The camera track its setup plays (any length: its offsets are its own)

params.label: Dust offsets
params.doc: Where each dust puff starts from the impact (x, y, z) (48 bytes: an edited one keeps its length)

params.label: Dust directions

params.label: Puff x offsets
params.doc: Each puff's x offset (+ a random 0..0x31F, - 0x190) (20 bytes: an edited one keeps its length)

params.label: Puff z offsets

params.label: Debris x offsets

params.label: Debris z offsets
